facts.business: ULTRACAB (INDIA) LIMITED manufactures cables and wires, and grants brand usage rights to Jigar Cables Limited for a 2% royalty on basic sales.
facts.related_party_note: Material Related Party Transactions with Jigar Cables Limited approved up to Rs. 200 Crores for the period from the conclusion of this AGM until the next AGM, including sale/purchase/supply of goods, leasing, services, and brand usage rights at 2% royalty on basic sales by JCL.
